name: I Love You
source:
A girl named Megumi transfers into an outstanding private school. She lived a normal life before; what will happen when she goes there?

Inside the school, there is an Enchanted Forest. Whoever goes there disappears. Is this rumor true?

Some say it's because of a student who went there. He kicked various plants and flowers which angered the Guardian of the forest. After that, he disappeared. Is this true? Or is this wrong?

Megumi is also single. Help her find a boyfriend.

[Edited from [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=21365]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
